_fields.listen: Server listening address for TCP and UDP (e.g. :8443)
_fields.target: Backend service to forward incoming tunnel streams to (e.g. 127.0.0.1:22)
_fields.transport: Strict transport protocol filter: 'all' (multiplexing gateway for H2+H3+WT+MASQUE+gRPC), 'h2' (strict HTTP/2 POST), 'h2c' (strict cleartext H2), 'grpc' (strict gRPC only), 'wt' (strict WebTransport only), 'masque' (strict RFC 9298 MASQUE only), 'h3' (strict HTTP/3 only)
_fields.network: Allowed proxy network types: 'all' (allow both TCP and UDP forwarding), 'tcp' (strictly allow TCP only, rejects UDP), 'udp' (strictly allow UDP only, rejects TCP)
_fields.token: Proxy-Authorization Token required from clients (aliases: auth_token, psk)
_fields.tls: Enable TLS encryption (automatically generates high-authenticity self-signed certificate if cert/key omitted)
_fields.cert: Optional path to custom TLS certificate file
_fields.key: Optional path to custom TLS private key file
_fields.local_only: Restrict forwarded target strictly to localhost to prevent open-relay abuse
_fields.log_level: Logging verbosity: debug, info, warn, error
